sn_aia_tool.description: Use this tool to finalize document intake after policy validation. Links the validated file to the case and financial task, updates the task state to Closed Complete, logs a professional summary note to the case activity stream documenting file upload details without technical IDs, and returns a reassuring confirmation for the client.
sn_aia_tool.input_schema: [{"name":"case_sys_id","description":"The sys_id of the lending case","mandatory":false},{"name":"case_number","description":"The case number (e.g. LNB0001001)","mandatory":false},{"name":"task_sys_id","description":"The sys_id of the completed financial task","mandatory":false},{"name":"task_number","description":"The number of the completed task (e.g. LTB0001001)","mandatory":false},{"name":"file_name","description":"The filename of the uploaded file","mandatory":true},{"name":"summary_notes","description":"Professional summary notes for the case activity stream","mandatory":false}]
sn_aia_tool.name: attach_and_confirm_case_document
